paragraphs.text: The proposer confirms compliance with the submission deadline specified in the RFP. The proposal will be submitted by September 15, 2023, at 4pm, as required. The proposer ensures that all necessary inputs will be provided to the bid manager by September 8, 2023, to facilitate timely submission.

Regarding shipping and handling requirements, the proposer partially complies with the specified conditions. The Metal Clad Switchgear section will be shipped as part of the Prefabricated Equipment Enclosure, with bolted shipping splits. However, the bus duct transition will require one field weld. This approach ensures the protection of auxiliary devices and accessories during transportation and handling.
